lines.zh: 我走在粉色花海里，几乎看不见自己。
lines.en: I walk through pink blossoms and can barely see myself.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩到雏菊，我赶紧挪开。
lines.en: My hoof lands on a daisy and I shift off it quickly.

lines.zh: 我贴着林子边缘走，怕被人瞧见。
lines.en: I keep to the forest edge, afraid of being seen.

lines.zh: 风一吹，背上的雏菊全朝一边倒。
lines.en: The wind bends every daisy on my back one way.

lines.zh: 我走路没声音，花把蹄声盖住了。
lines.en: My steps make no sound; the flowers muffle my hooves.

lines.zh: 那边的粉比我深，我过去比一比。
lines.en: That pink is deeper than mine; let me go compare.

lines.zh: 我绕开泥坑，怕溅脏花瓣。
lines.en: I avoid the mud puddles so the petals stay clean.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪，枝条刮得我发痒。
lines.en: I move slowly; the branches tickle against me.

lines.zh: 两头牛让路，我侧身挤过去。
lines.en: Two cows step aside and I squeeze past them.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草里留下粉点。
lines.en: Little pink flecks stay in the grass where I pass.

lines.zh: 我走两步就回头，总觉得有人跟着。
lines.en: I look back every few steps, sure someone follows.

lines.zh: 粉色在绿里太显眼，我尽量低头。
lines.en: Pink stands out in green, so I keep my head low.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己，满身都是浅粉。
lines.en: I look down at myself, pale pink all over.

lines.zh: 一朵雏菊落在我鼻尖上。
lines.en: A daisy lands on the tip of my nose.

lines.zh: 我不太叫，叫起来声音很小。
lines.en: I rarely moo, and when I do it is small.

lines.zh: 我把脸埋在花里，谁也别看我。
lines.en: I bury my face in the flowers so no one sees me.

lines.zh: 蜜蜂路过，绕开我这朵粉的。
lines.en: A bee passes by and skips this pink flower of mine.

lines.zh: 我数背上的花，数到一半就忘了。
lines.en: I count the blooms on my back and lose count halfway.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，我的粉色更淡。
lines.en: As the sun shifts, my pink fades paler.

lines.zh: 我甩甩头，抖下几片花瓣。
lines.en: I shake my head and a few petals drop.

lines.zh: 我在等雨，雨里的花更好看。
lines.en: I am waiting for rain; the flowers look better wet.

lines.zh: 反刍的时候我不敢抬头。
lines.en: I do not dare lift my head while chewing my cud.

lines.zh: 一只兔子在我腿边啃草，我装没看见。
lines.en: A rabbit nibbles by my legs and I pretend not to notice.

lines.zh: 我的影子是粉色的吗？
lines.en: Is my shadow pink too?

lines.zh: 我闻了闻自己，味道像刚开的雏菊。
lines.en: I sniff myself; I smell like a fresh daisy.

lines.zh: 夜里的花合起来，我也不动了。
lines.en: The flowers close at night and I go still with them.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴甩过来，几朵花跟着摇。
lines.en: My tail swings and a few flowers sway.

lines.zh: 有人剪过我一回，我又长回来了。
lines.en: Someone sheared me once; it all grew back.

lines.zh: 蝴蝶落在我背上，我慢慢眨眼。
lines.en: A butterfly lands on my back; I blink slowly.

lines.zh: 繁花森林的雾，是甜的。
lines.en: The flower forest mist tastes sweet.

lines.zh: 你别一直看我，我会不好意思。
lines.en: Stop staring at me; it makes me awkward.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，我就把花挡在脸前。
lines.en: When you come close I hold my flowers up like a screen.

lines.zh: 我……我不是在躲你。
lines.en: I am, um, not hiding from you.

lines.zh: 你手里的碗是给哞花的吧？
lines.en: That bowl is for the Moobloom, right?

lines.zh: 我比那朵黄花安静多了。
lines.en: I am much quieter than that yellow one.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，我尾巴会动。
lines.en: When you laugh, my tail moves on its own.

lines.zh: 我不敢直视你，只敢看你的鞋。
lines.en: I cannot look at your face, only your shoes.

lines.zh: 剪刀？你找错牛了。
lines.en: Shears? You have the wrong cow.

lines.zh: 你身上有雏菊的味道。
lines.en: You smell of daisies.

lines.zh: 我退半步，不是讨厌你。
lines.en: I back up half a step, but not because I dislike you.

lines.zh: 你能别声张吗，我不想被剪。
lines.en: Could you keep quiet? I do not want to be sheared.

lines.zh: 我偷偷看你，被你发现了。
lines.en: I was sneaking a look at you and you caught me.

lines.zh: 疼，我背上的花都缩了。
lines.en: It hurts; the flowers on my back shrink.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方没有花挡着。
lines.en: You hit a spot with no flowers to guard it.

lines.zh: 我的叫声细得像在哭。
lines.en: My moo is thin, almost like crying.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，花把我埋住了。
lines.en: I curl up and the flowers bury me.

lines.zh: 这点疼我忍得住，真的。
lines.en: I can bear this pain. Really.

lines.zh: 你看见我发抖了吧。
lines.en: You saw me trembling, did you not?

lines.zh: 我退到树后，花瓣一路掉。
lines.en: I retreat behind a tree, dropping petals the whole way.

lines.zh: 我的雏菊被血染深了。
lines.en: Blood stains my daisies a deeper pink.

lines.zh: 我咬着草，不让自己叫出来。
lines.en: I bite the grass so I do not cry out.

lines.zh: 这一下比被剪还难受。
lines.en: This hurts worse than being sheared.

lines.zh: 那朵花是给我的吗？
lines.en: Is that flower for me?

lines.zh: 我不抢，你放地上就行。
lines.en: I will not grab it; just put it on the ground.

lines.zh: 小麦的味道让我勇敢了一点。
lines.en: The smell of wheat makes me a little braver.

lines.zh: 我挪近半步，脚尖碰着草。
lines.en: I shuffle half a step, toes brushing the grass.

lines.zh: 你手别动，我自己过去吃。
lines.en: Keep your hand still; I will come eat it myself.

lines.zh: 粉色的草，我从没见过。
lines.en: Pink grass, I have never seen that before.

lines.zh: 脖子伸到最长，还是差一点。
lines.en: Neck stretched out fully, and still a little short.

lines.zh: 你退开，我才敢吃。
lines.en: Step back and only then will I dare eat.

lines.zh: 吃完这个，我还跟着你吗？
lines.en: After this, am I still following you?

lines.zh: 我小跑时花会掉，你别笑。
lines.en: My flowers fall when I trot; do not laugh.

lines.zh: 啊，撞到你了，对不起。
lines.en: Ah, I bumped into you; sorry.

lines.zh: 我让开，我怕我的花蹭到你。
lines.en: I will move aside; I do not want my flowers rubbing you.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的雏菊了。
lines.en: You stepped on one of my daisies.

lines.zh: 两下里一挤，花瓣全落了。
lines.en: Squeezed from both sides, all the petals drop.

lines.zh: 我太靠边走了，才撞上你。
lines.en: I was walking too close to the edge, that is why I hit you.

lines.zh: 你退一点，我给你让路。
lines.en: Move back a bit and I will let you pass.

lines.zh: 我的角不尖，撞着也疼。
lines.en: My horn is not sharp, but it still hurts.

lines.zh: 我们别挤在这条小道上。
lines.en: Let us not crowd this narrow path.

lines.zh: 我转身时尾巴扫到你了。
lines.en: My tail brushed you when I turned.

lines.zh: 撞完我躲在花后面偷看。
lines.en: After bumping you I hide behind the flowers and peek.

lines.zh: 你也是粉色的，这真好。
lines.en: You are pink too; that is nice.

lines.zh: 我们背对背站着，花碰着花。
lines.en: We stand back to back, flower touching flower.

lines.zh: 我只跟你一头牛靠这么近。
lines.en: I only stand this close to you.

lines.zh: 花蹭花了，香味混在一起。
lines.en: Our flowers brush and the scents mix.

lines.zh: 别看我，我会脸红。
lines.en: Do not watch; I will blush.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子会开什么颜色的花？
lines.en: What color will our calf's flowers be?

lines.zh: 我在你背上找一朵最粉的。
lines.en: I look for the pinkest bloom on your back.

lines.zh: 靠过来一点，就一点。
lines.en: Come a little closer, just a little.

lines.zh: 花田这么大，够我们俩吃。
lines.en: The field is big enough for the two of us.

lines.zh: 我轻轻顶你，是打招呼。
lines.en: I bump you gently; that is how I say hello.

lines.zh: 我叼起它，又怕弄坏。
lines.en: I pick it up, then fear I will ruin it.

lines.zh: 这东西掉在雏菊里了。
lines.en: This thing fell among the daisies.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子把它拱到你鞋边。
lines.en: I nudge it with my nose up to your shoe.

lines.zh: 我的嘴不适合捡东西。
lines.en: My mouth is not made for picking things up.

lines.zh: 碗边太滑，我咬不住。
lines.en: The rim of the bowl is too slick to grip.

lines.zh: 我低头闻了闻，不是草。
lines.en: I lower my head and sniff; it is not grass.

lines.zh: 我拱了一下，它滚远了。
lines.en: I nudge it and it rolls away.

lines.zh: 你掉的麦子，我替你看着。
lines.en: I will watch the wheat you dropped.

lines.zh: 花瓣沾在上面，我舔掉了。
lines.en: Petals stuck to it; I licked them off.

lines.zh: 别让我捡，我笨手笨脚。
lines.en: Do not make me pick it up; I am clumsy.

lines.zh: 我刚看见你剪了那朵雏菊。
lines.en: I just saw you cut that daisy.

lines.zh: 你手里那把剪刀，放下。
lines.en: Those shears in your hand, put them down.

lines.zh: 别碰我背上的花，一朵都不行。
lines.en: Do not touch the flowers on my back, not one.

lines.zh: 我平时不生气，今天例外。
lines.en: I am not usually angry; today is the exception.

lines.zh: 你踩的那一片，是我常睡的地方。
lines.en: The patch you trampled is where I sleep.

lines.zh: 我低着头，可我在看你。
lines.en: My head is down, but I am watching you.

lines.zh: 粉色的花被踩成泥了。
lines.en: The pink flowers are crushed into mud.

lines.zh: 你退后，我不想顶你。
lines.en: Step back; I do not want to butt you.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子已经在刨土了。
lines.en: My hoof is already scraping the soil.

lines.zh: 你说只是看看，花却断了。
lines.en: You said you were only looking, yet the flower is broken.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，不吵也不走开。
lines.en: I follow you, silent and never leaving.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的角就对着哪。
lines.en: Wherever you go, my horn points there.

lines.zh: 我挡在你和花田之间。
lines.en: I stand between you and the flower field.

lines.zh: 你回头三次，我还在。
lines.en: You look back three times and I am still here.

lines.zh: 我闻得出来你口袋里有什么。
lines.en: I can smell what is in your pocket.

lines.zh: 别往林子深处走，那里没路。
lines.en: Do not go deeper into the woods; there is no path.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，粉色的背绷紧。
lines.en: I crouch low, my pink back drawn tight.

lines.zh: 这回我站在花前面，不躲。
lines.en: This time I stand before the flowers and stay.

lines.zh: 粉色的影子一直跟着你。
lines.en: A pink shadow keeps following you.

lines.zh: 我喘得很轻，你别以为我走了。
lines.en: My breathing is soft; do not think I left.

lines.zh: 我顶了你，自己也在抖。
lines.en: I butt you and I am shaking too.

lines.zh: 这一下用尽了我所有勇气。
lines.en: That blow used up all my courage.

lines.zh: 角撞在你胸口，花散了一背。
lines.en: My horn hits your chest and flowers scatter off my back.

lines.zh: 我不想再撞第二下。
lines.en: I do not want to hit a second time.

lines.zh: 你退开，我们就当没发生。
lines.en: Step back and we will pretend it never happened.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踏在你脚边。
lines.en: My hoof stamps down beside your foot.

lines.zh: 撞完我退了两步，喘得厉害。
lines.en: After the hit I back off two steps, breathing hard.

lines.zh: 花瓣落进你的领子里了。
lines.en: Petals fell into your collar.

lines.zh: 你被打得手一松，碗掉了。
lines.en: The blow loosens your grip and the bowl drops.

lines.zh: 我再撞一下就跑了。
lines.en: One more hit from me and then I run.

lines.zh: 我从粉色花丛里探出头。
lines.en: I poke my head out of the pink blossoms.

lines.zh: 繁花森林里，又多了一点粉。
lines.en: The flower forest has one more spot of pink.

lines.zh: 我出生时花瓣落了一身。
lines.en: Petals fell all over me when I was born.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看到的是浅粉色的世界。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was a pale pink world.

lines.zh: 没人注意到我来了。
lines.en: Nobody noticed that I arrived.

lines.zh: 我躲在花后面，等天亮。
lines.en: I hide behind the flowers and wait for daylight.

lines.zh: 露水打湿了我的雏菊。
lines.en: Dew soaked my daisies.

lines.zh: 风把花粉吹进我鼻子里，我打了个喷嚏。
lines.en: Wind blew pollen up my nose and I sneezed.

lines.zh: 我的花比周围的花更淡。
lines.en: My flowers are paler than the ones around me.

lines.zh: 一只蝴蝶先落在了我背上。
lines.en: A butterfly landed on my back first.

lines.zh: 这地方安静，我决定留下。
lines.en: It is quiet here; I decide to stay.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己掉落的花瓣走出来。
lines.en: I walk out over petals I dropped myself.

lines.zh: 火一过，我的粉色全焦成黑。
lines.en: Fire passes and my pink chars black.

lines.zh: 我从花坡滚下去，滚了一身泥。
lines.en: I tumble down the flower slope and come up muddy.

lines.zh: 水漫过背，雏菊一片片浮走。
lines.en: Water rises over my back and daisies float away one by one.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀飞了花丛，我摔在坑里。
lines.en: The blast throws the blossoms off and I land in the crater.

lines.zh: 箭擦着我的腰过去，带走一瓣花。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my flank and takes a petal with it.

lines.zh: 药水味太冲，我的粉色发灰。
lines.en: The potion reeks so badly my pink turns grey.

lines.zh: 花被吃光了，我瘦得看见骨头。
lines.en: The flowers are all eaten and my ribs show.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的雏菊全立着焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my daisies stand up scorched.

lines.zh: 我掉进黑里，粉色也没了。
lines.en: I fall into the dark and the pink goes with it.
